description: Adds a rival the owner names to Market › Rivals (as Add one you know does there), kept as the owner's: no search takes it off. Give its name and its site. kind is direct unless the owner says otherwise: adjacent when it does only one important part of the job, substitute when it is what buyers do instead (a habit, a tool, doing it themselves), which may have no site. The same name again changes its kind or site, and one the owner set aside comes back on the list. Every rival named is listed; a direct one with a site is also studied while fewer than 7 are. From then on it is read with the other rivals, as that work already runs and at what it costs; adding is free. set_aside takes one off. Only a rival the owner named, never a guess.

kind.description: direct (the default): the same promise to the same buyers; adjacent: does only one important part of the job; substitute: what buyers do instead

name.description: its name, as people say it

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

sells.description: what it sells, to whom, at what price, when the owner said

name: rival_add
title: Add a rival
